ai_summary: Allcargo Logistics Limited announced the immediate resignation of its Founder, Director, and Chairman, Mr. Shashi Kiran Shetty, effective August 5, 2026, citing "professional and personal commitments." This represents a significant leadership transition as a key founding figure departs the company. While attributed to common reasons, such a material departure, especially from a founder, could introduce uncertainty regarding future strategic direction or operational stability, warranting close investor monitoring.
